zone: 1. Low, Medium & Geostationary Earth Orbit (400–35,786 km)
representative_systems: Starlink (~11,150 laser-mesh LEO sats), ISS Spaceborne Computer-2, Earth-observation AI CubeSats, GPS/Galileo, Hubble, Tiangong
dominant_hardware: Commercial radiation-screened ARM/Linux SoCs, Xilinx/AMD FPGAs, phased-array DSPs & ISS server GPUs
source: McDowell (2026) Jonathan's Space Report; ESA Space Environment Report (2025); HPE Spaceborne Computer-2

representative_systems: James Webb Space Telescope, Euclid, Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, Chandrayaan-2 Orbiter, Danuri, Queqiao-2, SOHO, DSCOVR
dominant_hardware: BAE RAD750, LEON3/4 SPARC fault-tolerant processors & cryogenic focal-plane ASICs
source: Gardner et al. (2023) PASP 135:068001; Racca et al. (2024) A&A (Euclid); NASA/CNSA/KARI/ISRO mission status (2026)

zone: 3. Inner Solar System & Asteroid Belt Cruise (10M – 450M km)
representative_systems: Parker Solar Probe, Solar Orbiter, BepiColombo, Psyche (optical laser), Lucy, Hera, OSIRIS-APEX, Tianwen-2
dominant_hardware: RAD750 & LEON3 radiation-hardened CPUs with autonomous thermal/optical navigation
source: Fox et al. (2016) Space Sci. Rev. 204:7; Levison et al. (2021) Planet. Sci. J. 2:171; ESA Hera / NASA Psyche (2026)

zone: 4. Mars Surface & Orbit Network (~225M km mean)
representative_systems: Perseverance & Curiosity rovers, Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, Odyssey, MAVEN, Mars Express, ExoMars TGO, Tianwen-1 Orbiter, Hope
dominant_hardware: RAD750, RAD6000, Xilinx Virtex-5 Vision FPGA (Perseverance) & UHF/X-band orbital relay
source: Verma et al. (2023) Sci. Robot. 8:eadf8058; Francis et al. (2017) Sci. Robot. 2:eaan4582; NASA Mars Relay Network (2026)

representative_systems: Juno (at Jupiter), Europa Clipper & JUICE (cruising to Jupiter/Ganymede), New Horizons (Kuiper Belt at 64.2 AU)
dominant_hardware: RAD750 inside titanium radiation vaults (Juno/Europa Clipper), LEON-FT (JUICE) & Mongoose-V (New Horizons)
source: Bolton et al. (2017) Space Sci. Rev. 213:5; Pappalardo et al. (2024) Space Sci. Rev. 220:40; Fountain et al. (2008)

zone: 6. Interstellar Space Beyond the Heliopause (21.6B – 25.9B km)
representative_systems: Voyager 1 (~173.1 AU / 1 light-day) & Voyager 2 (~144.3 AU), plus two 1-billion-year Golden Records
dominant_hardware: Six 1970s 16/18-bit plated-wire & CMOS processors per probe + Pu-238 RTGs + 23 W X-band transmitters
source: Stone et al. (2013) Science 341:150; Stone et al. (2019) Nat. Astron. 3:1013; NASA JPL Voyager Status (Nov 2026)

zone: TOTAL ACTIVE OFF-EARTH FLEET (All Space Beyond Earth, 2026)
representative_systems: All ~17,500 Earth-orbiting satellites + 41 cislunar, planetary, Kuiper Belt & interstellar spacecraft
dominant_hardware: 99.998% LEO constellations & ISS; <0.002% deep-space radiation-hardened explorers
source: Closed Off-World Hardware Synthesis (2026); equals 0.000010% (1 in 10 million) of Earth's 1.89×10^22 digital ops/s
